task_criteria:
Criterion A: tests/selftest.sh section 29 has two git-form arms that drive 'python3 scripts/board_drift.py check --workdir <repo> --ref <ref>' with NO --published-dir and NO --no-head. Proof: run 'bash tests/selftest.sh 2>&1 | grep git-form ancestry' and quote two PASS lines, one naming an ancestor case with RESULT: OK and one naming a sibling commit with RESULT: DRIFT. The arms assert the literal rows 'PASS  HEAD ancestry' and 'FAIL  HEAD ancestry'.
FAILIF: either arm is absent, or both arms only cover one direction.
PROOF: the two quoted PASS lines at HEAD.

Criterion B: at HEAD, 'bash tests/selftest.sh' prints 'SELFTEST: PASS' with exit 0, and the seven existing publish-drift fixture arms still print PASS rows.
FAILIF: SELFTEST is not PASS, or a publish-drift arm regressed.
PROOF: quoted SELFTEST line plus the seven publish-drift PASS lines.

Criterion C: the new arms are causally falsifiable. In a worktree of HEAD with scripts/board_drift.py's condition 'if not args.no_head and not args.published_dir:' replaced by 'if False:', the suite prints 'SELFTEST: FAIL (2)' with rows 'FAIL  git-form ancestry present' and 'FAIL  git-form ancestry absent'. The graded repo tree must be unmodified afterwards: 'git status --porcelain' empty and sha256 of scripts/board_drift.py equal to 'git show HEAD:scripts/board_drift.py | sha256sum'.
FAILIF: the disabled run still prints SELFTEST: PASS, or the graded tree carries an edit.
PROOF: quoted disabled-run lines and the clean-tree/sha256 comparison.

items.detail: Ran `bash tests/selftest.sh` at HEAD (log /tmp/st_head.log). grep 'git-form ancestry' gives exactly two PASS lines: line 259 `  PASS  git-form ancestry present (HEAD=137c20af4ec8fb06d83dea1c9a78c4e59cc00b2b ancestor of main=7f6e5527378f701c7d8f64430e986df4bdd5ef5c) -> RESULT: OK` and line 260 `  PASS  git-form ancestry absent (HEAD=2e218015c5741e46b3f6b8227647963e1a0f44bd not an ancestor of main=7f6e5527378f701c7d8f64430e986df4bdd5ef5c) -> RESULT: DRIFT`. Both arms call the helper `drift_git_form` (tests/selftest.sh:1583-1586) which runs `python3 -B "$HERE/scripts/board_drift.py" check --workdir "$1" --ref "$2"` with no --published-dir and no --no-head (invoked at :1602 and :1618). The green arm asserts `grep -Fq 'PASS  HEAD ancestry'` + `grep -Fxq 'RESULT: OK'` (:1604-1605); the red arm asserts `grep -Fq "FAIL  HEAD ancestry — HEAD=$drift_sibling main=$drift_tip; "` + `grep -Fxq 'RESULT: DRIFT (1 failed)'` (:1620-1621). Both directions covered.

items.criterion: Criterion B: at HEAD, 'bash tests/selftest.sh' prints 'SELFTEST: PASS' with exit 0, and the seven existing publish-drift fixture arms still print PASS rows.
items.detail: Full suite run at HEAD: /tmp/st_head.log ends with `SELFTEST: PASS` (last line, no FAIL rows anywhere in the 586-line log). The seven publish-drift arms all PASS: lines 252-258 `PASS  publish-drift red fixture, exit 1` / `green fixture, exit 0` / `zero fixture, exit 1` / `missing fixture, exit 1` / `malformed fixture, exit 1` / `nonobject fixture, exit 1` / `event-drift fixture, exit 1`. (The suite takes ~2.5 min, so it was run detached with output captured to the log rather than inline.)

In a worktree of HEAD with scripts/board_drift.py's condition 'if not args.no_head and not args.published_dir:' replaced by 'if False:', the suite prints 'SELFTEST: FAIL (2)' with rows 'FAIL  git-form ancestry present' and 'FAIL  git-form ancestry absent'. The graded repo tree must be unmodified afterwards: 'git status --porcelain' empty and sha256 of scripts/board_drift.py equal to 'git show HEAD:scripts/board_drift.py | sha256sum'.
items.detail: Created `git worktree add --detach /tmp/cf128wt HEAD` and replaced the single occurrence of `if not args.no_head and not args.published_dir:` with `if False:` (now scripts/board_drift.py:165 in that worktree). Disabled run (/tmp/st_disabled.log) ends with `SELFTEST: FAIL (2)` (line 614) and contains `  FAIL  git-form ancestry present (exit 0)` (line 259) and `  FAIL  git-form ancestry absent (exit 0)` (line 274); the seven publish-drift rows still PASS in that run. Graded tree afterwards: `git status --porcelain` shows only the pre-existing untracked `.gitreins/history/2026-11-08/902bbd8d/` (present in the very first status before any work, and no tracked modification), `git diff --stat HEAD` empty, and `sha256sum scripts/board_drift.py` = b29b898f7b1d1c6358d396c561036dfc9ab6e78267bd96c9d47f79381a610477 which equals `git show HEAD:scripts/board_drift.py | sha256sum` = b29b898f7b1d1c6358d396c561036dfc9ab6e78267bd96c9d47f79381a610477. The scratch worktree was removed with `git worktree remove --force`.

items.criterion: The two new arms are hermetic — they build their own scratch git repo (no dependence on the graded repo's own git state/remotes) and clean it up, so the suite stays green on a host without network/global git config.
items.detail: tests/selftest.sh:1587-1596 creates `$tmpd/head-ancestry` under `mktemp -d` with its own board files and `git init -q -b main`; the helper `drift_fixture_git` (:1577-1582) runs git with `env -u GIT_DIR -u GIT_WORK_TREE -u GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null` plus `-c user.email/-c user.name/-c commit.gpgsign=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null`, so no host identity, hooks or global config is consulted and the graded repo's git state is never touched. Cleanup at :1631 `rm -rf "$tmpd"`. The suite ran green in this environment (SELFTEST: PASS).

items.criterion: The red arm cannot pass for the wrong reason — it asserts the measured HEAD/ref pair and an exact 'RESULT: DRIFT (1 failed)', so an unrelated failing row in the fixture cannot satisfy it.
items.detail: tests/selftest.sh:1619-1622 requires exit 1, the measured pair `FAIL  HEAD ancestry — HEAD=$drift_sibling main=$drift_tip; `, `grep -Fxq 'RESULT: DRIFT (1 failed)'` (exact line, so a second failing row would break the match) and no `Traceback`. The disabled-tool run shows every other row of that fixture is green — /tmp/st_disabled.log:260-273 lists PASS workdir files / published ref / sha256 / byte parity / board rows and `RESULT: OK` — so only the ancestry row can produce the single failure.

items.criterion: The arms' helper functions and variables are unique to §29 and do not collide with names used elsewhere in selftest.sh.
items.detail: `grep -n 'drift_fixture_git|drift_git_form|drift_repo|drift_base|drift_tip|drift_sibling|drift_out|drift_rc' tests/selftest.sh` returns hits only within lines 1577-1631 (the §29 block); no hits outside tests/selftest.sh in any .sh/.py file, so the new helpers cannot shadow or be shadowed by earlier sections.
